game_title: Continue Gate – Dragon Hoard Cave Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled iron keys but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled iron keys but keep the loop running. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the crystal door using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The crystal door reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the crystal door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
